name: Synth Invaders
author: Addicting Games
description:
Synth Invaders is a retro-inspired shooter heavily influenced by arcade classics like Galaga and Space Invaders. It is designed to preserve the nostalgic feel of original coin-op games while adding a third dimension to the experience. In the true spirit of the arcade, your primary objective is simple: survive the onslaught and achieve the highest score possible.

 

Game Features

Diverse Arsenal: Choose from 5 different weapon types, each with unique strengths and weaknesses tailored to different playstyles.

Scaling Difficulty: The challenge intensifies with every victory. After each boss defeat, enemies become progressively more powerful, and new enemy types emerge to test your reflexes.

Dynamic Visuals: Experience a shifting atmosphere as the environment evolves based on your progress.
